text:
alana: heads-up from usability today: new users didn't find the sampling control — they expected it near the time range. also several complained the low-density heatmap colors looked like background noise. recording + notes: https://staging.redwood.com/rec/discoverability-206 :mag:
govind: thanks. two quick things: 1) make sampling visible on first-run via a subtle onboarding pulse on the control area; 2) increase min contrast for low buckets or add an optional pattern overlay.
ryan: onboarding pulse idea is good. we could show a one-time inline hint: 'Try sampling to lower query cost' with a small chevron pointing to the control. keep it dismissible and keyboard-focusable.
sam: a11y notes: onboarding hints must not trap focus and should be reachable by keyboard if they appear. also provide an accessible label: 'Sampling controls, press S to open' and `aria-keyshortcuts="S"`. For pattern overlays, ensure patterns are exposed to screen readers as an alternative text description when enabled.
jon: implementation notes: onboarding should be purely CSS+small JS to avoid blocking load. pulse once then fade. For pattern overlays on canvas heatmaps, precompute a tiny 8x8 pattern canvas and use createPattern to reduce draw cost. toggle pattern by a user setting in accessibility menu to avoid runtime costs for everyone.
govind: microcopy suggestion: change 'Auto' -> 'Adaptive' and show helper 'Adaptive: preserves tail samples while lowering requests'. also rename the menu entry from 'Sampling' to 'Sampling & cost' for clearer discoverability.
ryan: mobile placement question: should the onboarding pulse highlight a top-right kebab if we hide the control there? my thought: if sampling is collapsed into kebab on narrow screens, pulse the kebab and show a short toast: 'Sampling (tap to open)'. keep toast non-modal.
sam: SR behavior: when onboarding hint appears, announce politely: 'Tip: sampling controls available. Press S to open.' Avoid forcing focus. Also throttle any live-region updates so users aren't spammed.
a11y-bot: checklist generated: ['onboarding hint keyboard accessible', 'aria-keyshortcuts S', 'sampling labelled "Sampling & cost"', 'pattern overlay opt-in via accessibility settings', 'precompute pattern canvas for perf', 'toast non-modal and dismissible']. link: https://staging.redwood.com/a11y/checks/206
alana: perf caveat: adding pattern overlays for every low bucket caused a measurable frame drop in a local stress test. so opt-in only and cache patterns per palette. jon will own perf.
jon: got it. i'll add pattern caching + worker offload for pattern generation. also will ensure pulse animation uses transform/opacity only and respects prefers-reduced-motion.
govind: owners: jon (patterns + perf), sam (SR copy + keyshortcut), ryan (onboarding UI + mobile toast),alana (product copy + acceptance). Acceptance: first-run users see non-blocking hint pointing to sampling, sampling control labelled "Sampling & cost", pattern overlay available in accessibility settings, no frame drops on large dashboards, and SR can open and interact with sampling via keyboard shortcut.
sam: i'll run NVDA/VO once PR lands and confirm the polite announcements and shortcut registration.
alana: thanks team  filing the parent ticket and attaching the recording. closing this thread for async work. :white_check_mark:
